items.title: Actual phase accuracy and expected work with identical witnesses

source.anchor: Algorithm3.1 HTML282-306; D2/AlgorithmD.2 HTML2099-2164; D4 final expected-work paragraph2182-2186; B1 actual coefficients1684-1713
source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang. ASTIS bounded actual-implementation accuracy/work integration; neither full main theorem.

items.statement: There exist one measurable exact optimality map p, one measurable stopped output map q and one measurable N:E→Nat such that p(y)+eta*gradient V(p(y))=y, ||q(y)-p(y)||<=eps, p is nonexpansive and the actual residual-stopped interpreter from y returns some(q(y),N(y)+1) with sufficient fuel N(y)+1. The identical p,q,N define actual full-phase Markov Kp,Kq, the actual output Phi_q and the actual total returned gradient count T. For every state s and finite real rho>=1, true Euclidean W_rho(Kq(s),Kp(s))<=3hLambda eps. Under the same actual driving law mu=nu prod gamma, T is measurable, real-integrable and E_mu[T]<=J(2+L0+L1). For every driving input w the counted phase interpreter with fuel(y)=N(y)+1 returns exactly some(Phi_q(w),T(w)). All output/count/kernel/cost conjuncts share these witnesses.
assumptions: E is a complete finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel sigma algebra, including dimension zero. V:E→R is C2; kappa>=1 and kappa^-1||v||²<=D²V(x)[v,v]<=||v||² for every x,v (normalized beta=1).

J>=2; h>0; actual t_i=h/2(1-cos(i*pi/(J-1))), i=0,...,J-1; ell_j=Lagrange.basis(univ,t,j); Lambda=sup_{s∈[0,h]}sum_j|ell_j(s)|; omega_ij=integral_0^{t_i}(t_i-s)ell_j(s) ds; pw is the final omega row and b_j=integral_0^h ell_j(s) ds. Assume only h²Lambda<=1; h<=1 is derived.
0<eta<=c<1 and eps>0. c is a contraction upper-bound parameter in the cost certificate, not an algorithm parameter or additional gradient query.

nu is the actual incoming phase-state probability measure. xstar∈E satisfies gradient V(xstar)=0; M>=0. The real function ||X-xstar||²+||P||² is nu-integrable and its nu-expectation is <=M. These actual-state moment hypotheses are explicit; no TV approximation or independently sampled proxy law is substituted.

gamma=((stdGaussian(E) prod stdGaussian(E)) prod (gi prod gi)), where gi=Measure.pi_{Fin J}(stdGaussian(E)); all four factors and each array coordinate are independent. mu=nu prod gamma. Write w=((X,P),((zeta0,zeta1),(G0,G1))), a=exp(-h/2), sigma=sqrt(1-exp(-h)) and P0=aP+sigma*zeta0.

For any f:E→E define Y0_i=X+t_iP0, Z0_f,j=gradient V(f(Y0_j)+sqrt(eta)G0_j), Y1_f,i=Y0_i-sum_j omega_ij Z0_f,j, Z1_f,j=gradient V(f(Y1_f,j)+sqrt(eta)G1_j) and Phi_f(w)=(X+hP0-sum_j pw_j Z1_f,j, a(P0-sum_j b_j Z1_f,j)+sigma*zeta1). The exact and approximate branches have their own Y1_f. For the constructed q,N set T(w)=2J+sum_i[(N(Y0_i(w))+1)+(N(Y1_q,i(w))+1)].

Set d=finrank_R E, S=h²Lambda/2, MR=M+(1-exp(-h))*d, B=6MR+3eps²+3eta*d, C=2+(1+log((1-c)^(-1)))/(-log c), L0=C*(1+log(1+sqrt(2MR)/eps)) and L1=C*(1+log(1+sqrt(4MR+2S²B)/eps)). W_rho(mu1,mu2) is [inf_{pi coupling(mu1,mu2)} integral (sqrt(||DX||²+||DP||²))^rho dpi]^(1/rho), expressed in extended nonnegative reals, for every finite real rho>=1.

Run-wide analytic bounds and both main results/composition (remaining)

bindings.boundary: One successful exact-real source two-layer phase with actual integral coefficients and all four Gaussian factors, joining real accuracy and expected returned query cost. The exact comparison phase uses exact proximal stochastic gradients, not deterministic gradient V_eta. N(y)+1 is a sufficient execution certificate, not a free runtime computation of N. Counts include terminal residual tests and 2J shifted noisy-gradient calls; arithmetic, random draws and failed-run cost are separate. No TV-to-unbounded-cost transfer. Run-wideD3 contraction/history/D7/D8, B2/depth-K/logarithmic Lambda/weight positivity/source parameter choices/smoothing/Wp/proxy-warmness/initialization/PBPS/main results and actual-input composition remain open.
